verdict.description: FAIL if there is at least one blocking finding; otherwise PASS.

findings.description: All findings from this review round. Empty array means a clean review.

id.description: Stable short id for this finding, e.g. F1, F2. Reuse the same id across rounds when the finding persists.

blocking.description: true if leaving this unresolved would ship a wrong/unsafe result; false for quality improvements that do not change what gets built.

location.description: Where the issue is, e.g. file:line, a spec section, or a plan step. Use 'n/a' if not localizable.

description.description: What is wrong and why it matters.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete suggested change. Use 'open question' if it needs a human decision rather than a fix.
